title: An operator who declares proxies while every client still arrives from one upstream address gets all viewers refused together
notes: Every viewer shares the counted address, so they are refused together. The server could notice many devices and names behind one counted address and warn, or keep a known device out of the address refusal. Beside BL-210; needs its own brief. Promote when an operator reports viewers refused together, or with JS-056 if its ingress is shown to pass one address for all clients.
